Be the envy of your network. 😎

NerdGram turns a few lines of Mermaid into clean, accurate network diagrams in no time, and you get enterprise-grade features without a paywall. It's free and open source, built to run local-first (I'd sure appreciate a ⭐ on GitHub though 😉).

Because if it isn't diagrammed, it's just a rumor. 🔥

Success is just a docker pull away.
